svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top face: four 16.2 mm gland holes, 45 mm in from the back face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 and 60 mm each side of the centre (40 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom face: one 16.2 mm hole 45 mm in from the back, 60 mm right

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of centre (seen from the front) for the supply lead.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back: use the box's own corner fixing holes, outside the seal

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (about 170 x 220 mm apart here; follow the box you buy).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside the back: four moulded bosses, 160 x 200 mm apart, carry the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mounting plate; check them on your box before drilling the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape, pilot 3 mm, step drill slowly, deburr. No solvents.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit an M16 gland in each hole, nut inside, seal outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each gland seal sits flat; nothing cracks round a hole.
